svg.title: From allocation lines to contract signing
svg.desc: Budget staff build allocation lines from the act. Procurement reads the lines, raises a requisition and reserves money. The case moves through its method, and e-GP results are recorded. At signing the reservation becomes a commitment in one transaction, and an event tells finance and projects.
